fields.name: GdiplusVersion
fields.description:
Currently supported are versions 1, 2 and 3.
- version 1: available in Windows XP and up
- version 2: available on some Windows 10 and up
- version 3: enables Heif and Avif image codecs. These two codecs require COM to be initiailized.

fields.name: SuppressBackgroundThread
fields.description: FALSE unless you're prepared to call the hook/unhook functions properly

fields.name: SuppressExternalCodecs
fields.description: FALSE unless you want GDI+ only to use its internal image codecs.

types.name: GdiplusStartupOutput
types.description: Notification functions which the user must call appropriately if SuppressBackgroundThread is set.
